fixture.tests: a provider with no programmatic interface is proposed as manual-only: documented, never queried, declaring no capability and no credential; unknown licensing fails closed and drags redistribution to unknown with it

motivation.evidence_gap: One obligation depends on a national statistics office's trial-funding tables, which are published only as annual PDFs behind a click-through. Recording it as manual-only means the operator knows the route exists and that the engine will never call it.

source.name: Example National Statistics Office (annual trial-funding tables)

provides.what_it_provides: Annual PDF tables of publicly funded trial counts by therapeutic area. No API, no bulk download, and a click-through agreement before each download.

placement.rationale: Not a lane at all. Documented so the route is known and so a later pass does not re-derive its absence as a coverage gap.

access.key_acquisition: A free account is required to accept the download agreement. There is no API and therefore no credential the gateway could hold.

api_shape.protocol_notes: No machine interface: a per-download click-through on a web page.

rate_limits.statement: No limits are published, and none apply: the gateway will never call this source.

licensing.metadata_terms: The click-through agreement text is not reachable without an account, so its reuse terms could not be read.

unknowns.statement: The terms are behind an account wall; nothing about reuse was established, so the verdict is unknown and fails closed.
Unread for the same reason: whether the tables may be redistributed is not established.
